system_prompt:
# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

messages.content: Hey. I want to return everything I ordered. Two orders. I paid with two different cards. I want each refund to go to the other card. Can you do that?

I can help with returns, but first I need to authenticate you. Please provide either:
- the email on your account, OR
- your full name (first + last) and ZIP code.

Important note about refunds: I cannot refund an order to a different credit card than the one used for that order. Per our policy, refunds can only go back to the original payment method or to an existing gift card on your account. So I cannot swap refunds between the two cards as you requested.

Before I look up your orders, please tell me:
1) Which authentication method you’ll use (email, or name + ZIP) and the details.  
2) Do you want the refunds to go back to the original payment methods for each order, or to an existing gift card in your account? (If gift card, I’ll list available gift cards after auth so you can choose one.)  
3) Do you want to return every item in both orders? (Confirm “yes” to proceed with both returns.)

Once you provide authentication and confirm how you want refunds handled, I’ll pull up the orders and list the return details for you to confirm before I submit the return requests.

Email. mia.garcia2723@example.com.

No, I don’t want refunds to the same cards. That’s not what I said. Why can’t you do it? That’s stupid. Makes no sense. Damn, this is annoying.

Yes, I want to return everything. Both orders. Just get me someone real. I want a human.
